name: 8°10'N 92E
note: NW corner. Northern edge raised to 08d10'N so SAMAK (7.978N) is inside with 11 NM margin.

name: 8°10'N 094°50'E
note: NE corner. Eastern edge at 094d50'E, 25 NM EAST of the FIR boundary at 094d25'E, so trajectories either side of the boundary are sampleable. Supersedes the earlier 8N 094d00'E corner, which put the boundary and its four fixes outside the region.

name: NILAM
note: NILAM. Eastern bulge; the region must reach it because it is the last N571 fix before the boundary.

name: 4N 96E
note: Declared vertex 4N 96E, replacing IVRAR (absent from current navdata, likely renamed after 2014).

name: 6N 92E
note: West side closes back north at 92E. Western limit set by the Andaman/Nicobar chain, not by the boundary.
